about.bio:
My path hasn’t exactly been a straight line. I bootstrapped a supplement brand past US$130K in revenue in its first year, built the outbound sales motion at a shipping startup from scratch, and spent plenty of hours in front of the camera and on the gym floor coaching people.

On paper that probably looks scattered. To me it’s been different rooms, same question: what makes someone care?

I’m still chasing that answer, and in today’s day and age, I think it’s the most important question you can ask.

work.intro: I like being the first person through the door: building the brand, the funnel or the sales motion before there's a playbook for it. I live for creativity.

gorilla.story:
Gorilla Gear is a premium fitness and nutrition brand built for Asia. We launched in May 2025 and I bootstrapped it to more than US$130K ARR in the first 12 months.

I run the growth side end to end: paid acquisition, retention, B2B partnerships and the brand itself.
gorilla.points:
Grew revenue 10x through paid acquisition and B2B partnerships, reaching a consistent US$20K+ MRR
Ran Meta Ads at more than 4x ROAS, shipping about 30 creatives a month at peak with matching landing pages
Built Klaviyo retention flows behind a 30% repeat rate across 1,000+ customers
Closed 5+ B2B accounts across lifestyle and fitness channels through outbound
Ran gym and lifestyle activations; the largest drew 200+ people over two days

magicport.story:
MagicPort is an AI-powered maritime intelligence platform that digitizes port operations. As the first sales hire, I built the outbound motion and the cold prospecting playbook from scratch.

In my first 6 months I generated US$250K in outbound pipeline across 300+ shipping companies in 80+ countries.
magicport.points:
Work with the founders on go-to-market, refining messaging and qualification to lift meeting conversion
Run pipeline and sales activity in HubSpot

creative.intro:
I've spent a lot of time in front of the camera. As a commercial model I've worked on campaigns like Salomon's [Made for the Wild](https://sg.salomon.com/pages/made-for-the-wild) and Garnier's Box Dye. As a creator, I make UGC and short-form content for brands like L'Oréal and Descente for my 25K+ audience across [IG](https://instagram.com/drewtyl)/[TikTok](https://tiktok.com/@drewtyl).

Building Gorilla Gear changed how I see it.

I better understand how different types of content serve different purposes, and I strive to stay up to date with the ever-changing content meta.
